items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: And you know I played with rock & roll groups: Bobby Rydell

ctx.x: The person is the same. The character is wearing a different costume. I’m acting. Playing music is acting. Because you’re in a scenario, you’re in a landscape — see in a landscape if you see like a Monet painting, right, and it’s beautiful and everything. And all of a

sudden there’s a picture of a bicycle in the middle of it. That isn’t going to make it, unless it’s just for shock. You know what I mean? It’s to shock somebody or something. But in general, and some people like that kind of art. You know what I mean? But my job is not to do that. My job is to honor the composer. Jazz, classical, if I’m backing up Billy Joel or somebody. One of my friends who lives in Florida, that’s what his job is, Billy Joel. And you know I played with rock & roll groups: Bobby Rydell —…
